ad_info.reference_style: Lifestyle supplement ad with a woman from behind on the left half, the bottle in the center, an icon column and handwritten accents

global_identity.color_palette: Primary: hot fuchsia #E6177F and deep magenta #B0105E. Secondary: bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE, white #FFFFFF, aguaje orange #D9572B only for fruit accents.
global_identity.visual_style: Premium Latin American beauty-supplement ad: ultra-photorealistic woman in short fitted shorts in a bright bedroom, the black-and-fuchsia bottle as hero, clean icon column.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Feminine, confident and warm; soft daylight.
global_identity.graphic_language: Fuchsia rounded pill, hot fuchsia circles with thin white line icons, a round pink brush-stroke seal with white handwritten script, soft pink petal shape in the corner, thin vertical dividers between bottom trust items, real aguaje fruits.
global_identity.text_typography: Poppins Bold (heavy, uppercase) for the headline, Poppins Regular for icon texts, casual handwritten script for the accents.

creative_objective: Stop the scroll with a real body taking half the image and explain why it works: three extracts together (aguaje, fenogreco and maca negra) plus vitamins A and E.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The woman from behind on the left half. 2) The headline top-right. 3) The bottle in the center. 4) The icon column, seal, trust row and script accent.
art_direction.composition_style: Left half: the woman bleeding off the left edge. Top-right: headline block with pill. Center-right: the bottle large with capsules and fruits. Far right: vertical column of four icons with text. Left lower third: round seal overlapping the photo. Bottom: a row of three trust items on white; bottom-right corner: script accent on a pink petal shape.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Woman 0-52% width, 0-88% height. Headline 4-20% height on the right 52%; pill about 21-26%. Bottle about 35-80% height centered at 55% width. Icon column 72-97% width, 30-75% height, four evenly spaced rows. Seal about 3-25% width, 62-82% height. Trust row 88-98% height across the left 70%. Script accent bottom-right 75-98% width, 82-98% height.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft window daylight; the room is slightly blurred behind the woman; glossy highlight on the bottle with a soft shadow on the white surface.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Bright bedroom with a plant. Left half: a woman seen from behind from waist to upper thigh, in short fitted shorts and a white top, one hand on her hip, cropped by the left edge. Top-right: a two-line headline (bold uppercase line and a script line), then a fuchsia pill with white text. Center: the bottle large standing on a white surface with two pink capsules in front and aguaje fruits with leaves behind its right side. Right: a column of four fuchsia circles with white line icons, each with short text. Lower-left: a round pink brush-stroke seal with white handwritten text. Bottom: a row of three trust items (line icon plus two-line uppercase text) separated by thin dividers. Bottom-right corner: a pink petal shape with white handwritten text and a small heart.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 premium supplement lifestyle ad in a bright bedroom with soft window daylight, pale blush pink walls, a green potted plant and a dresser softly blurred in the background. LEFT HALF, bleeding off the left edge, photographed from a low camera at hip height: an ultra-photorealistic Latina woman in her mid 20s seen from behind, from mid-back to mid-thigh, long dark hair falling on her back, wearing a fitted white crop top and very short fitted dusty rose cotton shorts, one hand resting on her hip; her glutes are full, round and lifted and her thighs toned, with natural, believable volume. Maximum realism: real skin texture with visible pores, natural creases, subtle skin tone variation, realistic fabric texture, real photo quality; no plastic or airbrushed skin; tasteful, non-explicit fitness styling. TOP-RIGHT: headline in two lines: a bold uppercase line in hot fuchsia (#E6177F) and below it a large handwritten script line in deep magenta (#B0105E); under it a hot fuchsia rounded pill with white text. CENTER, large, standing on a white surface: the product. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product, and do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it: a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' pattern and a hot-pink band around the bottom fifth; black label with the pink VITALABH emblem, huge white 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a pink banner 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS', italic pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN', three pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE' + '400mg FENOGRECO' + '200mg MACA NEGRA', and '60 CÁPSULAS'. Two glossy fuchsia capsules lie in front of it and real aguaje fruits with shiny scaly reddish-brown skin, one cut in half showing orange flesh (#D9572B), with green leaves sit behind its right side. FAR RIGHT: a vertical column of four rows, each a hot fuchsia circle with a thin white line icon (an aguaje fruit, a small seed pod, a root, a vitamin capsule) and short two-line text in dark gray to its right. LOWER-LEFT, overlapping the photo: a round bubblegum pink brush-stroke seal with white handwritten script text in three lines. BOTTOM, across the left 70 percent on a white strip: a row of three trust items separated by thin gray vertical dividers, each a deep magenta line icon (a capsule, a bottle, a leaf) with two-line bold uppercase text in deep magenta. BOTTOM-RIGHT CORNER: a hot fuchsia soft petal shape with white handwritten script text in two lines and a small white heart below. Include only these elements and texts.
